svg.title: A strategy proposes its next setting and cannot adopt it: one real run
svg.desc: RSI on 2026-10-12, in five numbered steps. One: the rsi row as the file holds it, with today's setting and the settings it may try; the twelve are drawn as a grid of six look-back lengths by two ways of reading the number, the row today on 14 sessions read as a rebound and the search picking 28 sessions read as strength continuing. Two: a gate judges the best of them on five checks, each with what was measured and what it needs: 705 sessions against 60, a range of 0.0171 to 0.1117 against chance and 0.0408 to 0.2195 against today's setting, both above zero, 0.0 against a ceiling of 0.5, adjusted prices. Three: two second opinions, after trading costs and on the statistics alone, would pass it. Four: the ledger holds two entries, a candidate on all 28 names and a refusal on the 16 whose prices were confirmed as adjusted, whose range, minus 0.043 to 0.0529, crosses zero. Five: only later sessions count from here, none of 60 scored yet, and the edit to the row, 14 sessions to 28, has not been proposed and would need a person's review.

text.tspan: CLAWOCK · A STRATEGY THAT SEARCHES ITSELF
It may propose its next setting. It cannot adopt it.
One real search, drawn from the ledger: RSI on 2026-10-12, 28 names, Goldwind among them.
01 · IT TRIES ONLY WHAT WAS DECLARED
Twelve settings, declared before the search. All twelve are counted, so a lucky one cannot pass as the only one.
02 · A GATE JUDGES THE BEST OF THEM
sessions it was not tuned on
chance it was fitted to the past
A configuration line can make this gate stricter,
never looser than the floor in the code.
They can block. They cannot pass
0 · the whole range has to stay above it
every name the lab has prices for
On the 16 confirmed names, Goldwind among them, the search is refused: its range crosses zero.
The result leans on the other 12, where one provider’s word is all there is.
05 · THEN IT HAS TO KEEP WORKING
what the search was judged on
After 60 later sessions, and only if it passes the check it
fails today, the lab may propose an edit to the row.
A search is a result about the past: it places no order and changes no live setting.
